nuggets.text: The Pirates run onto the field to Jimi Hendrix's 'Purple Haze' before kickoff at Dowdy-Ficklen Stadium.
A cannon fires when the Pirates run onto the field, and again after every score.
Between the third and fourth quarters, the Pirates swap their black Jolly Roger for a burgundy 'No Quarter' flag.
Before they were the Pirates, East Carolina's teams were called the Teachers, until a name change in 1934.
Blake Harrell was named the Pirates' interim head coach on October 20, 2024, his 45th birthday.
Blake Harrell went 4-0 as the Pirates' interim coach in 2024, and that winning streak earned him the permanent job.
The Pirates are back-to-back Military Bowl champions, beating NC State in 2024 and Pittsburgh in 2025.
Quarterback Mitch Griffis played at Wake Forest and Texas Tech before landing with the Pirates for 2026.
The Pirates went 9-4 in 2025, Blake Harrell's first full season as head coach.
Dowdy-Ficklen Stadium was dedicated in 1963 and holds up to 50,000 fans.
